title: Menu overhaul, part 4: reset the live public header from its stale database copy to the code menu

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-04 17:32Z: 'full menu restructure, everything but admin' (the live header still showed Feed, Community, Spaces, About, Discover, For Spaces). Strategy report: /mnt/project-files/menu-strategy-2026-11-03/REPORT.md

detail:
The menu overhaul (#4546, #4564, #4588) changed the code, but production reads the public header from `menus` rows (surface_key 'header', no Space), which outrank the code. The row still held the pre-overhaul Community, Spaces and About menus (links to retired pages included), and a 2026-11-04 menu sync appended Discover and For Spaces after them. Migration 20270346029900 deletes the global header menu (categories, items and rail cards cascade) so getMenu('header') returns the code default: Discover, For Spaces, Business Spaces, Pricing, Help. Space-owned header menus are untouched. Apply to production once, then redeploy or wait out the hour of revalidate. Probe: node scripts/probes/header-code-menu.mjs. Evidence to append the same day: production applied and the header verified.

Migration 20270346029900 resets the global header menu to the code default; probe passes on this branch. Production apply and live check follow.
